name: notebook-forge
description: Create illustrated study PDFs with topic-specific teaching images, separate media permission and double verification; optional GIFs in HTML.

interface.shortDescription: Illustrated study PDFs with verified teaching images
interface.longDescription: Ask permission for images and GIFs separately. Illustrate every topic and subtopic when approved; verify technical integrity, topic alignment and readability. PDFs use static images; approved GIFs play in HTML.
defaultPrompt: Create illustrated study notes; ask my permission for images and GIFs first.
Create a notebook with at least one relevant teaching image per topic, if I approve images.
